blocks.html:
Vinyl Decals

This customer found Vinyl Wrap Toronto online to redo his DPS Vinyl Decals. He was looking for stickers to be taken off his car and new ones added. The vehicle had been partially wrapped before and was already distinctive with the black vinyl over the silver paint. The client already had the logos from the company and worked with the design team to place them on the vehicle. Branding on a vehicle is one of the cheapest forms of advertising. While on the road or on site, you stand out and show off your brand.
Your company logo as moving billboard is a great way to be constantly advertising. Our installation team had to remove the old perforated vinyl on the back window and replaced with DPS Vinyl Decals.

This vehicle was getting completely rebranded at the client’s request. The images show the before and after of the vehicle’s transformation. While installing certain decals, the graphics team and installation crew found ways to improve future wraps. Vinyl Wrap Toronto has been wrapping vehicles for many years and we are still learning and improving. Click here to view more information about the vinyl material we use to wrap equipment and vehicles. This wrap took about 3 days from start to finish, which is normal for this size vehicle. Whether we are just doing decals or a full wrap, the vehicle still needs time to warm up and stay warm after the install.

Visit us at 24 Ronson Drive, Unit 1, Etobicoke to speak to one of our experienced team about your company vehicle wrap.
